# R

```{r}
score <- c(90, 85, 88, 92, 95)
```


# Python

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.arange(1, 11)
y = x ** 2

plt.plot(x, y)
plt.show()
```

`reticulate::repl_python()`在console界面运行Python代码块，输入exit或者quit退出Python环境

##  Python调用R变量
```{python}
print(r.score)
```

```{python}
x = [10,20,30,40]
```
